author: James Mayger, Yian Lee
description: The status of Taiwan’s sovereignty is one of the world’s most contentious political questions.

author: Nancy Cook
description: Donald Trump’s hand-picked candidate for a congressional seat in Northern Kentucky, Ed Gallrein, defeated the president’s nemesis and longtime GOP House member Thomas Massie in one of the most expensive primaries on record.

description: Josh McKoon, Chairman of the Georgia Republican Party, says voting is “generally” going smoothly in Georgia on primary day and that he's “cautiously optimistic” Republicans can hold the House majority in November. He discusses President Trump’s influence in Republican primaries, the race he expects will head to a runoff, the consideration of new congressional maps and why Georgia remains a very competitive state. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power” live from Atlanta, Georgia. (Source: Bloomberg)

description: Adam Stulberg, Chair and Professor at Georgia Tech’s Sam Nunn School of International Affairs, says energy markets are unlikely to return to their pre-conflict normal, as displaced tankers, depleted supply stocks, damaged infrastructure and weakened market shock absorbers keep pressure on prices. He discusses the prospect of NATO joining efforts to stabilize shipping through the Strait, Europe’s energy vulnerabilities and how elevated oil prices could affect Georgia voters, consumers and businesses heading into November. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power” live from Atlanta, Georgia. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Stulberg Says Energy Problems Will Persist After Strait Reopens

description: Andre Dickens, Mayor of Atlanta, says turnout has been “pretty good” on primary day in Georgia and that affordability is top of mind for voters, citing the cost of rent, gas, food and health care. Dickens discusses his Neighborhood Reinvestment Initiative, including investments in affordable housing, early childhood learning and food access. He also discusses how Atlanta is using artificial intelligence, and how the city is preparing to host FIFA World Cup matches in 2026. He speaks with Kailey Leinz and Joe Mathieu on the late edition of Bloomberg’s “Balance of Power” live from Atlanta, Georgia. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Affordability Is Top Issue for Voters: Atlanta Mayor

description: Alli McCartney, UBS Alignment Partners private wealth advisor and managing director of wealth management and Bloomberg rates reporter Michael Mackenzie, discuss the bond market landscape as yields push higher on fears around accelerating inflation. Then, Brett Mufson, president of Fontainebleau Development breaks down the consumer landscape on Las Vegas tourism and the state of the consumer. Plus, Nathalie Morrison, founder of lab grown diamond company Astrea London on the rise of lab grown gemstones and its impact on the diamond market. (Source: Bloomberg)

Stephen Lawson, Principal in Dentons' Regulatory, Public Policy and Government Affairs Practice & Republican Strategist joined Balance of Power to discuss the primaries happening across the country today as well as  President Donald Trump endorsed Texas Attorney General Ken Paxton in the state’s Republican Senate primary race. 

 (Source: Bloomberg)

description:
Bloomberg Daybreak Europe is your essential morning viewing to stay ahead. Live from London, we set the agenda for your day, catching you up with overnight markets news from the US and Asia. And we'll tell you what matters for investors in Europe, giving you insight before trading begins.

On today's show, President Trump says he's called off fresh attacks on Iran that had been planned for Tuesday, after an appeal by leaders in the Middle East. The US President says Saudi Arabia, Qatar, the UAE and others have told him they're "getting very close to making a deal". Oil slipped on the news, but stocks in Asia and US futures fell, as optimism faded for a deal to end the war.

European Union officials are due to meet to try to finalize the trade deal with the US. Failure to reach an agreement could mean missing President Trump's July 4 deadline, risking a fresh round of tariff escalation. (Source: Bloomberg)
title: Iran War: Trump Holds Off on New Strikes | Daybreak Europe 05/19/2026
